Slop Time · free, in your browser

A timeanddate.com alternative for world clocks and time zones

Slop Time puts a world clock, a time zone converter, a meeting planner, a stopwatch and a countdown on one page. It runs in your browser and keeps your cities on this device.

Open Slop Time

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Time. The World clock starts with London, New York and Tokyo.
  2. Search Add a city or time zone to add your own cities; Remove takes one off.
  3. Use Convert to see a time in every city, and Meetings to find the hours when everyone is at work.
  4. Set your zone and working hours on My time to see where your day overlaps with another city.
  5. Use Timers for a stopwatch with laps or a countdown.

Each city card shows the local time with seconds, the day, the offset from GMT, and whether it is a working day and inside working hours there. Everything is worked out by your browser from its own time zone data, with no request to a time server.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Time runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slopographic part of timeanddate.com?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with timeanddate.com or its owner. timeanddate is a trademark of its owner, named here only for comparison.

How exact is the time?

It is your device clock. If that is off, the Sync tab lets you type a time from a source you trust and the clocks move by the difference. Slop Time never fetches the time from the network.

Are my cities saved?

Yes, in this browser: the city list, your working hours and any clock offset are kept in local storage on this device and sent nowhere.
